summary: Backend + Frontend testing for ChinguSpeak 3 features (category learning screen, gamified XP progression, full i18n). Backend 6/6 pytest passed for POST /api/modules/content (previously 404, now returns proper JSON with title/intro/steps/practice_prompts), /api/ping, /api/public/settings. Frontend: /scenarios chip bar renders all 5 chips (All + daily/travel/work/school), tapping Travel navigates to /category/travel; progress card, tier chips 1/2/3, vocab, phrases, AI booster, complete button all render with correct testIDs. Tier 2 locked chip shows 'Unlocks at Level 2' locked-hint at level 1. AI intro content loaded live from backend (~5s). 'Mark module complete' awards +40 XP (xp-toast '+40 XP earned!' shown). Simulated XP=59 + Work module complete triggers LevelUpModal with 'Level 2 · Explorer'. Profile screen shows 'Your Progress' card. i18n verified: KO ('실생활 상황을 연습해요', '여행'), ES ('Practica situaciones de la vida real', 'Viajes'), AR ('السفر') all translate live on Settings > App Language change.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Not breaking, but noise-level warning. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow definition used across scenarios.tsx, category/[tag].tsx, profile-screen.tsx).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Likely originates from a wrapper (LinearGradient / SafeAreaView) — non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Suppress or migrate deprecated React Native Web warnings (theme shadows -> boxShadow; pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking.

OPTIONAL: Consider adding data-testid to each language row in /settings/app-language (e.g. app-lang-en, app-lang-es, app-lang-ko, app-lang-ar, app-lang-fr) for easier automated testing. Right now testers must click by localized text.
